name: brand-color-input
title: Brand Color Input
description: Names the closest palette token with a perceptual (OKLab) distance and offers a one-tap snap when a value is slightly off (#1e40ae vs #1e40af); catches pasted junk, O for 0, wrong digit counts, alpha in 4/8-digit hex and Android #AARRGGBB order.

meta.stops: Brand colour off by a hex digit
meta.summary: A colour field that names the nearest brand token and offers a snap when a value is a hair off, so near-miss brand colours don't ship.
catches: Values a hair away from a palette token, with a snap to the token
The letter O typed for zero, and stray characters from a paste
A digit too many or too few
Android #AARRGGBB order, which CSS reads as a different colour
limits: Only knows the palette you pass; with no palette it checks syntax only
"Close" is a perceptual distance threshold, so an intentional near-shade can be flagged
a11y: Visible <label>; the hint is linked with aria-describedby and is aria-live="polite"
aria-invalid when the value can't be read
Fix buttons have aria-labels naming the token and value; the swatch is aria-hidden
The flash on fix is skipped with prefers-reduced-motion
